decisions.decision: Removed --turbopack from dev script only (kept in build script)
decisions.rationale: Sentry 10.49.0 crashes in Next.js 15.5.15 Turbopack edge runtime. Webpack dev works fine.
minify-sanity.mjs postinstall runs npx terser which fails on Vercel without terser in node_modules.
^6 range pulled in TS 6.0.3 which breaks CSS side-effect imports under moduleResolution:bundler.

decisions.decision: Never use Vercel CLI to set env vars — use Vercel UI or REST API with type:plain
decisions.rationale: CLI stored corrupt base64-encoded blobs for env var values instead of plain strings.
lefthook install runs as prepare script during pnpm install and tries to write git hooks; fails in Vercel CI with exit code 1.

decisions.decision: Replaced FlatCompat with native eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals + /typescript flat imports
decisions.rationale: FlatCompat + eslint-plugin-react@7 circular JSON crash on ESLint 10; also eslint-plugin-react@7 calls context.getFilename() removed in ESLint 10 flat config API. React version pinned to 19 to bypass auto-detect.
